groups.name: llm4s
groups.description: LLM4S client: the flat openai/anthropic/ollama keys, or any provider under llm4s.providers.

groups.name: llm4s.async
groups.description: Sizing of the executor behind LLM4STemplate.completeAsync.

properties.name: llm4s.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the LLM4S beans; false registers none of them.

properties.name: llm4s.provider
properties.description: The provider of the flat form: openai, anthropic or ollama. Required unless llm4s.providers.* is set, which configures any provider on the classpath.

properties.name: llm4s.model
properties.description: The model name as the provider spells it. Required with the flat form.

properties.name: llm4s.api-key
properties.description: The API key of the flat form: required for openai and anthropic, not used by ollama.

properties.name: llm4s.base-url
properties.description: Overrides the flat-form provider's default URL.

properties.name: llm4s.organization
properties.description: OpenAI only: the organisation id.

properties.name: llm4s.context-window
properties.description: The model's context window in tokens; must be positive.

properties.name: llm4s.reserve-completion
properties.description: Tokens kept for the reply; at least 0 and less than the context window.

properties.name: llm4s.async.max-threads
properties.description: Maximum worker threads of the default llm4sTaskExecutor (idle threads time out).

properties.name: llm4s.async.queue-capacity
properties.description: Pending completeAsync calls the default executor queues before rejecting new ones.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe
properties.description: Opt in to a real provider call (one token) per health probe; off by default because it bills.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe-ttl
properties.description: How long a probe result is reused, so health polling does not hit the provider each time.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe-timeout
properties.description: A probe slower than this is cancelled (interrupting the provider call) and reports DOWN.

properties.name: llm4s.providers.provider
properties.description: The name of the llm4s.providers.<name> section the starter uses. Each section sets provider (a provider id such as gemini, azure, bedrock or openai-compatible), model and, as the provider needs, api-key, base-url and the provider's own keys.

properties.name: llm4s.providers
properties.description: Named provider sections, llm4s.providers.<name>.<key>, mirroring the llm4s.providers block of llm4s's HOCON configuration. Setting any of them replaces the flat llm4s.provider form.

properties.name: llm4s.credentials
properties.description: Shared vendor keys, llm4s.credentials.<provider>.api-key, used by a section that sets no api-key of its own.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.url
properties.description: HTTP proxy every provider client goes through, http://host:port (an http proxy, with its port); a user:password@ in it is the proxy's credentials. Mirrors llm4s.http.proxy.url of the HOCON configuration, which reads HTTPS_PROXY. Empty for none.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.username
properties.description: User name for the proxy's Basic authentication.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.password
properties.description: Password for the proxy's Basic authentication; never logged.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.non-proxy-hosts
properties.description: Hosts reached directly, not through the proxy: a name (localhost), a domain suffix (*.internal), a prefix (10.*) or *. Replaces the default, the loopback addresses.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.trust-store
properties.description: Path of a trust store (PKCS12 or JKS) of CA certificates trusted in addition to the JDK's, such as a corporate CA behind TLS inspection.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.trust-store-password
properties.description: Password of the trust store; never logged.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.key-store
properties.description: Path of a key store (PKCS12 or JKS) holding the client certificate for a gateway that requires mutual TLS.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.key-store-password
properties.description: Password of the key store and its key; never logged.
